rules.statement: A purchaser of land who has a conveyance from his vendor, but has never had any possession, may maintain an action to eject from the land a third party claiming title adversely to the vendor.
rules.supporting_quote: A purchaser of land who has a conveyance from his vendor, but has never had any possession, may maintain an action to eject from the land a third party claiming title adversely to the vendor.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Appuhamy v. Appuhamy (1880) 3 SCC 61 following Don Andris v. Illangakoon (1857) 2 Lor. 49
